title: The Great Lakes (and major North American lakes) by surface area (freshwater Areas)
description: Each entry is an Area: the surface extent a lake spans, in square kilometres. The five Great Lakes together are the largest surface of fresh water on Earth; a few other major North American lakes are included for context. A real, sourced geographic area model spanning the US-Canada border.

provenance.primary_source: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) — Great Lakes physical features
provenance.cross_reference: Encyclopaedia Britannica (Areas and Volumes of the Great Lakes); Natural Resources Canada for Great Bear / Great Slave lakes
provenance.note: Surface areas rounded; the five Great Lakes' combined surface is about 244,106 km2. Values are OBSERVED. Areas are alphabetized by lake name for reader ease; the group field marks the five Great Lakes.

reference.note: largest surface of fresh water in the world (the five Great Lakes only)
